patch_list: Customizes Home, navigation, account and search surfaces, and optional rating prompts.
Hides selected player branding, recommendations, outro cards and optional comments and danmaku.
Disables internal Bilibili telemetry, APM profiling, TradPlus ad mediation, Firebase analytics, Crashlytics, and Facebook AppEvents.
Uses Morphe GmsCore for Google sign-in and sign-out.
Hides selected feed, splash, floating, push, overlay and under-player advertisements.
Filters known user videos and creator surfaces, keeps Anime search, and preserves unknown official content and download management.
